personnelNotes: The charter names only these two officers. Its process tables identify everyone else by position and division.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Answer the Client Satisfaction Measurement Survey at the front desk of the office, or email gso.legazpi@gmail.com. The office is on the ground floor of the City Hall compound, Rizal Street, Barangay 13 Ilawod West.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: Every Friday the Officer-in-Charge compiles and records the feedback submitted. Feedback needing an answer goes to the division concerned, which must reply within two days of receipt, and the office's answer is relayed to the client. Complaints are evaluated by the Officer-in-Charge, forwarded to the division concerned for explanation, written up in a report for the Department Head to act on, and the outcome is given back to the client.

services.title: Filing a purchase request and getting the mode of procurement certified
services.description: The purchase request is prepared by the end-user office for supplies, property or equipment. It is the basis for canvassing before a purchase order is drawn up. Once the City Mayor approves it, the Bids and Awards Committee certifies which mode of procurement applies.
services.office: General Services Office, Administrative and Procurement Divisions
services.whoMayAvail: End-user offices and departments of the city government

requirements.item: Approved procurement plan by the end-user, department head or City Mayor

steps.client: Present the duly approved purchase request, obligation request and annual procurement plan, approved by the end-user, department head or City Mayor, with the supporting documents attached.
steps.agency: Checks and receives the approved purchase request and obligation request with the supporting documents.
Prepares the certification for the mode of procurement, to be signed by the Bids and Awards Committee members.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide VI / Administrative Aide I, Procurement Division

services.title: Posting a procurement on PhilGEPS
services.description: Every government procurement has to be posted on the Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System, the central portal for government procurement information.
services.whoMayAvail: End-user offices and departments of the city government

requirements.item: Approved purchase request and obligation request

steps.client: Present the approved purchase request, obligation request and certification.
steps.agency: Posts the details of the documents on the PhilGEPS website at https://www.philgeps.gov.ph.
steps.personResponsible: Senior Administrative Assistant II / Administrative Aide II, Procurement Division

services.title: Request for quotation and abstract of canvass
services.description: The request for quotation sets out the specification, quantity, approved budget for the contract and terms for the items being procured, and goes to at least three qualified suppliers, contractors or consultants. The abstract of canvass and award summarises the quotations that come back.
services.office: General Services Office, Procurement and Administrative Divisions
services.whoMayAvail: Suppliers, contractors and consultants, and end-user offices

steps.client: Present the approved documents for procurement and the supporting documents.
steps.agency: Prepares and dispatches the request for quotation to at least three suppliers, contractors or consultants of known qualifications.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Officer I / Administrative Aide I, Procurement Division

steps.agency: Prepares the abstract of canvass and award once the dispatched quotations are back from the suppliers, contractors or consultants, for the signature of the Bids and Awards Committee members.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Officer I / Administrative Aide IV / Administrative Aide I, Administrative Division

verifyNotes: The extraction shows three processing-time values (1 day, 1 day, 2 days) against two agency actions. The third is read as the TOTAL row, which reconciles: one day plus one day is the two days shown. Check the PDF.

services.title: Preparing a purchase order
services.description: The purchase order goes to the winning supplier or bidder, telling them to deliver the requested quantities of supplies, goods or property on the stated terms.
services.whoMayAvail: Winning suppliers and bidders, and end-user offices

requirements.item: Approved abstract of canvass and award

steps.client: Present the approved abstract of canvass and award and the approved documents for procurement.
steps.agency: Prepares the purchase order once the quotations and the abstract of canvass and award are complete.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Assistant VI / Administrative Assistant II / Administrative Aide IV, Procurement Division

services.title: Accepting a delivery and issuing the supplies
services.description: Inspection and acceptance of a delivery against the approved purchase order, then issuing the items. A property acknowledgement receipt covers property worth Php 50,000.00 and above; an inventory custodian slip covers supplies or equipment worth Php 14,999.00 or below. Both are signed by the accountable employee.
services.whoMayAvail: End-user offices and departments of the city government

requirements.item: Delivery receipt, charge invoice, statement of account, sales invoice, or official receipt if the supplier has a collection receipt

steps.client: Present the delivery receipt, charge invoice, statement of account, sales invoice or official receipt, together with the complete procurement and supporting documents.
steps.agency: Inspects and accepts the delivered supplies or equipment, prepares the acceptance and inspection report, and prepares the requisition issue slip.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide IV / RMO II, Procurement Division

steps.client: Present the approved requisition issue slip.
steps.agency: Prepares the property acknowledgement receipt or the inventory custodian slip.
steps.personResponsible: City General Services Officer (CGDH I) / Administrative Aide IV, Procurement Division

steps.agency: Releases the supplies or equipment to the client or end-user.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Officer I, Administrative Division / Administrative Assistant I, Administrative Aide IV and RMO II, Procurement Division

notes: Which form you sign depends on what the item cost: Php 50,000.00 and above gets a property acknowledgement receipt, Php 14,999.00 and below an inventory custodian slip.
verifyNotes: The charter lists five agency actions against three processing times. The grouping recorded here reconciles with the charter's own total of two days and four hours, but which actions share the three hours should be checked against the PDF.

services.title: Submitting the COA receipt
services.description: The COA receipt goes to the Commission on Audit so the city's procurement transactions stay on record.
services.whoMayAvail: End-user offices and departments of the city government

steps.client: Present the approved documents for procurement and the supporting documents.
steps.agency: Prepares the COA receipt on receiving the documents, then submits it to the Commission on Audit.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide II / Administrative Aide I, Procurement Division

services.title: Clearing a completed procurement
services.description: Once a procurement is finished, the office marks the file to show the transaction followed the proper procedure under Republic Act 9184.
services.whoMayAvail: End-user offices and departments of the city government

steps.client: Present the approved documents for procurement and the supporting documents.
steps.agency: Indicates on the file documents that the transaction is completed.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Assistant II / Reproduction and Machine Operator II, Procurement Division

services.title: Filing a letter of intent as a prospective bidder
services.description: A letter of intent formally declares that a party intends to do something needing action or acknowledgement from another, and usually comes before a binding document such as a contract.

steps.personResponsible: Senior Administrative Assistant II / Clerk IV, Procurement Division

services.title: Asking the Bids and Awards Committee a question
services.description: Queries about the Bids and Awards Committee, which advertises invitations to bid, runs pre-procurement and pre-bid conferences, determines bidder eligibility, receives and evaluates bids, undertakes post-qualification, and recommends contract awards and sanctions under R.A. 9184.
services.whoMayAvail: Prospective bidders and the general public

steps.client: Present your queries about BAC concerns.
steps.agency: Receives the queries for immediate response.
steps.personResponsible: Senior Administrative Assistant II / Administrative Assistant II / Administrative Aide IV, Procurement Division

services.title: Following up a solicitation approved by the City Mayor
services.description: A solicitation letter may ask for a donation, for business, or for the Mayor's presence at an occasion. Where the City Mayor approves a request for a donation, it comes to the General Services Office to be procured and released.
services.whoMayAvail: Anyone whose solicitation letter the City Mayor has approved

Approved purchase request, purchase order or requisition issue slip

steps.agency: Receives the letter request for the procurement process.

Administrative Aide IV / RMO II, Procurement Division

services.title: Getting a clearance when you leave city employment
services.description: The clearance an employee needs when retiring, resigning, transferring to another office, going on official leave, or travelling abroad while still in government service. It clears you of the property and equipment you are accountable for, which has to be transferred, returned or condemned first.
services.office: General Services Office, Administrative and Records Divisions
services.whoMayAvail: City government employees who are retiring, resigning, transferring or going on leave

requirements.item: Clearance form for retirement, resignation, transfer or leave

steps.client: Present the clearance form for retirement, resignation, transfer or leave, and request the transfer, return or condemnation of property, plant and equipment if that applies.
steps.agency: Checks the accountabilities of the client.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Officer I / Administrative Aide IV / RMO II, Administrative and Records Divisions

steps.agency: Recommends the next steps to complete the clearance form, prepares the property acknowledgement receipt or inventory custodian slip for a transfer, prepares the form for returning items, prepares the inspection and inventory or report of waste materials for property, plant and equipment, and submits it initialled and dated to the department head for final signature.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Officer I / Administrative Aide IV / RMO II, Administrative and Records Divisions

steps.client: Have the clearance approved by your department head.
steps.agency: The department head signs the document and it is released to the client.
